timing: Fix a panic bug on unmarshaling incomplete logs. Formerly timing.Log type contained "now" member to allow overriding time.Now calls in unit tests. In production it is almost always set to time.Now, but actually UnmarshalJSON left it nil, so importing an incomplete log caused a panic by nil function calls. This change removed "now" member from the struct but instead introduces "now" global variable whose default value is time.Now. device: led: probe the maximum value of brightness from ectool Previously in led.py, we assume the maximum value of brightness from the 'ectool led <name> <color>=<value>' command is 255. The actual maximum value may be different, e.g. 100. Using value larger than the maximum value is an unspecified behavior. On eve, it modulo the input value by the actual maximum value. In this case, the result is unwanted. This CL probes the maximum value of brightness using 'ectool led <name> query'. Also 'ectool led <name> <color>' set the brightness to 255, which always fails on devices with range check, e.g. nami. This CL makes brightness in LED.SetColor equal to 100 if not specified. BUG=None TEST=py/device/led_unittest.py Change-Id: Ia57d9a2d4ae2a6f3fb1cba76d46723c0521b8612 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1686797 Tested-by: Cheng Yueh <cyueh@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Cheng Yueh <cyueh@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org>
